blocks.title: GBX.NET
blocks.tagline: C# library for reading and writing Gbx files: maps, replays, items and more.

items.title: 500+ classes
items.text: High-performance serialization and deserialization of more than 500 Gbx classes.

items.title: All Nadeo games
items.text: Connects data of Trackmania, ShootMania and the older games.

items.title: Bulk processing
items.text: Suited to bulk changes, for example fixing broken sign URLs on hundreds of maps.

items.title: NuGet
items.text: Available as a NuGet package; the repository also holds templates and tools.

blocks.title: Good to know
blocks.markdown: GBX.NET is a developer library, not a game mod. Questions go to the issue tracker or the GameBox Sandbox Discord server.
